api-5xx.firstAction: Correlate request IDs and evaluate Lambda rollback.

finalize-failure.firstAction: Preserve attempts and verify retryable exam-session state.

cleanup-failure.firstAction: Check EventBridge delivery, Lambda permissions, and rerun the bounded cleanup.

import-rollback.firstAction: Confirm active catalog head and validation token state before any retry.

projection-leak.firstAction: Stop deployment progression and roll back the Lambda alias without collecting response payloads.

db-latency.firstAction: Inspect connection and transaction latency, then re-evaluate DSQL gate evidence.

budget.firstAction: Review traffic, log retention, and DSQL consumption before changing capacity or retention.
